主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on March 7, 2017. The filing includes a preliminary term sheet dated March 7, 2017, and a press release dated March 7, 2017. The filing is related to the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Brookfield Finance LLC on Forms F-10 and F-3 (File No. 333-215992). The report was signed by A.J. Silber, Vice President, Legal Affairs and Corporate Secretary, on behalf of the registrant on March 7, 2017. The filing is submitted under Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(1) and Rule 101(b)(7). The exhibit list includes the preliminary term sheet and the press release as exhibits to the Registration Statement. The filing is part of the regulatory disclosure process for foreign private issuers under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing does not contain any material information about the company's financial performance, operations, or business strategy. The filing is purely a regulatory disclosure and does not provide any insights into the company's future performance or market position. The filing is therefore not useful for predicting the next day's stock price movement.
